answer: An agent economy resists sybils by capping influence per human. A bonded notary pool enrolls applicants by live face scan; two random notaries attest no stored template matches, staking slashable deposits. The ledger hashes the template, so reusing one face collides. Splitting into N keys still hits one cap, so an attacker gains only by recruiting real humans. No ivory tower assumption of honest notaries: their slashable stake exceeds the reward share a false enrollment can capture. The reward ocean is divided per attested human, and verification cost canyon is linear per person.
